Square–octagon lattice: visual check

Blue dots: one spin on every small-square edge. Orange dots: two endpoint spins on every dummy link. Green dashed triangles show allowed singlet bonds. Hollow gray graph vertices are not extra spins.

Mapping correction: shrinking dummy links gives square-lattice loops with inherited routing, one-to-one relative to a reference covering. Earlier diagrams instead collapsed the small squares; their 2^N multiplicity does not apply to the intended contraction. The spin graph and previously calculated correlations are unchanged.

Lengths use simulation-cell translations, one small square per cell. This direction is diagonal on the square graph obtained by contracting dummy links.
